_readme: Add products to the array below and they appear at /shop/ with a page each at /shop/<slug>/. Every field except name is optional. See README.md for the full field list. While the array is empty the /shop/ hub stays noindex so an empty page is never submitted to Google; it becomes indexable automatically once a product is added.
affiliateDisclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you buy through one we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. It does not change what we list or how we describe it.
